messages:
rachel: starting a 4% canary for rwd-v7-int4 with a new 'sliceburst+entropy' leash. goal: catch concentrated quality regressions that also show token-distribution drift (KL) before global MRR moves.

priya: interesting. KL on token logits could surface hallucination style shifts. what's the concrete alarm shape?

rachel: plan: monitor per-cohort delta_nDCG, cohort_contrib_to_loss, token_KL (current vs baseline), and sample_entropy shift. define sliceburst if cohort_contrib >= 0.55 AND token_KL > 0.015 AND delta_nDCG < -0.005.

tom: combine both freq and distribution signals is smart. add min_samples and CI rules to avoid flapping.

rachel: yes. evaluation requires min_requests=25k OR min_time=10m. use bootstrap (1k resamples) for nDCG and percentile CI for latency. need either CI exclude 0 OR same-sign result for 3 consecutive windows to trigger.

alex: immediate rollback conditions?

rachel: immediate fallback if error_rate > baseline*2.5 OR p95_latency > baseline_p95*1.8 OR queue_p99 > baseline_queue*2.0. also if sample_entropy drops by > 15% and KL>0.03 -> immediate hold.

ci-bot: preflight smoke: unit tests pass, perf smoke ok. shadow job scheduled.

priya: promotion steps? sometimes int4 needs softer tail allowance early.

rachel: step policy: 4% -> 18%: allow p95_mul <=1.18, global_mrr_drop >= -0.006, no sliceburst. 18% -> 45%: p95_mul <=1.12, global_mrr_drop >= -0.003, max_cohort_loss_ratio <=0.4. 45% -> 100%: p95_mul <=1.08 and human signoff. human hold before final hop (30m).

tom: recommend tagging the fallback event with the dominant cohort, KL, entropy, and a S3 link to anonymized samples for triage.

rachel: agreed. event payload will include: ts, version, step_pct, reason_tag, primary_cohort, token_KL, entropy_delta, s3_samples_link.

priya: edge case: tiny cohorts with huge KL jitter. ignore cohorts with traffic_share < 0.4% unless abs_delta_nDCG > 0.01.

alex: add a derived metric: worst_case_token_shift = max(cohort_token_KL * cohort_traffic_share). alert if > 0.01.

ci-bot: shadow job-4122 started: synthetic longdocs (12k) and rerank set (8k). ETA ~30m.

rachel: proto-ish config: 

```
rollout_leash: {
  name: "sliceburst_entropy"
  cohorts: ["longdoc","rerank","short"]
  thresholds: {
    p95_latency_mul: "1.18"
    p99_queue_mul: "2.0"
    global_mrr_drop_step1: "-0.006"
    cohort_mrr_drop_cutoff: "-0.01"
    token_kl_alert: "0.015"
    token_kl_immediate: "0.03"
    entropy_drop_pct_immediate: "0.15"
    cohort_loss_ratio_alert: "0.55"
    min_requests: "25000"
    evaluation_window_sec: "600"
    bootstrap_resamples: "1000"
    consecutive_windows: "3"
  }
  immediate_fallback_on: ["error_rate","p95_latency","token_kl_immediate"]
  logging: { sample_per_cohort: "500", s3_retention_days: "14" }
}
```

tom: nice. also add a short human review window (15m) before auto-promote from 18%->45% with notification to #eng-ml.

rachel: will add. ci-bot will post automated snapshots at each promotion and any fallback.

ci-bot: shadow job-4122 results: longdocs 12k delta_nDCG = -0.92% (CI [-1.4%, -0.45%]) ; token_KL_longdocs = 0.017 ; entropy_drop = 9%. rerank +0.2%.

priya: KL of 0.017 and longdoc drop ~0.9% is concerning. by rule this hits sliceburst (cohort contribution ~0.62). recommend hold and sample upload.

rachel: holding promotion. uploading anonymized samples to s3://redwood-canary/rwd-v7-int4/samples/job-4122/ and opening a triage thread.

alex: request: run a KV-warm shadow and a multi-turn longdoc shadow to see if KV warmup or context chaining explains the drop.

ci-bot: scheduled additional shadows: job-4123 (KV-warm 10k), job-4124 (multi-turn 8k).

rachel: thanks team. i'll update the rollout config and runbook and file a short postmortem if we end up aborting. ping me for live adjustments.
